title: sambucus nigra subsp. canadensis
intro: Sambucus nigra subsp. canadensis, commonly known as American Black Elderberry, is a plant species belonging to the Adoxaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of American Black Elderberry include its ability to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of the common cold and flu. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
